morphology.pattern_note: 英语单音节词，字母 l 不发音；所列 IPA 为英式读音。syllables 的 sso 是原包异常值，依要求照录，不是有效分节。此词没有马来语词缀，Jawi 缺值保留。

word_family.gloss: walk 的过去式及过去分词

senses.zh_definition: 步行；以双脚交替迈步前进，亦可指步行经过某地或走完某段距离。
senses.en_definition: To travel on foot, or cover a route or distance on foot.
senses.ms_definition: Berjalan kaki atau menempuh laluan atau jarak dengan berjalan kaki.
senses.nuances: 英语动词，可不及物，也可带距离或路线宾语。马来语释义为编辑性对译，不是 DBP 对 walk 的官方释义。[Cambridge：walk](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/walk)

senses.zh_definition: 步行陪同某人到某处，通常为了送行、引路或照应。
senses.en_definition: To accompany someone somewhere on foot.
senses.ms_definition: Menemani seseorang berjalan kaki ke sesuatu tempat.
senses.nuances: 常见结构是 walk someone home 或 walk someone to a place。[Collins：walk](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/walk)

senses.zh_definition: 带动物步行活动，尤指遛狗。
senses.en_definition: To take an animal, especially a dog, out for exercise on foot.
senses.ms_definition: Membawa haiwan, khususnya anjing, berjalan untuk bersenam.
senses.nuances: 此义为及物用法，动物是宾语。[Cambridge：walk](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/walk)

senses.zh_definition: 一次步行或散步；也指以步行距离或所需时间计量的路程。
senses.en_definition: An outing on foot, or a distance measured by walking time.
senses.ms_definition: Kegiatan berjalan kaki atau jarak perjalanan yang diukur berdasarkan masa berjalan.
senses.nuances: 通常为可数名词；a ten-minute walk 表示十分钟的步行路程。[Collins：walk](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/walk)

collocations.ms: perjalanan berjalan kaki selama sepuluh minit

senses.zh_definition: 适合步行游览的路线或步道。
senses.en_definition: A path or route suitable for recreational walking.
senses.ms_definition: Laluan yang sesuai untuk kegiatan berjalan kaki atau bersiar-siar.
senses.nuances: 指路线本身，而不是一次步行活动。[Collins：walk](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/walk)

collocations.ms: laluan berjalan kaki di pesisir pantai

senses.zh_definition: 走路的姿态或步态；亦指区别于跑步的步行速度或步法。
senses.en_definition: A manner of walking, or a walking pace or gait.
senses.ms_definition: Gaya berjalan atau rentak pergerakan berjalan berbanding berlari.
senses.nuances: 可描述人的步态，也可指马等动物的慢步步法。[Merriam-Webster：walk](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/walk)

senses.zh_definition: 轻松通过考试或赢得比赛。
senses.en_definition: To pass a test or win a contest very easily.
senses.ms_definition: Lulus ujian atau memenangi pertandingan dengan sangat mudah.
senses.nuances: 英式非正式用法，不表示实际步行。[Cambridge：walk](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/walk)

senses.zh_definition: 棒球中指打者获保送上一垒，或投手保送打者。
senses.en_definition: In baseball, to receive or concede a base on balls.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam besbol, memperoleh atau memberikan kemaraan percuma ke bes pertama melalui base on balls.
senses.nuances: 可不及物或及物：打者可以 walk，投手可以 walk a batter。[Merriam-Webster：walk](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/walk)

collocations.ms: pemukul memperoleh kemaraan percuma ke bes pertama
membenarkan pemukul mara secara percuma ke bes pertama

senses.en_definition: A base on balls in baseball.
senses.ms_definition: Kemaraan percuma pemukul ke bes pertama dalam besbol melalui base on balls.
senses.nuances: 体育专门义，通常为可数名词。[Merriam-Webster：walk](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/walk)

collocations.ms: memperoleh kemaraan percuma ke bes pertama
kemaraan percuma ke bes pertama yang disengajakan

senses.zh_definition: 生活领域、职业或社会阶层，主要用于固定短语 walk of life。
senses.en_definition: An occupation, social background, or sphere of life.
senses.ms_definition: Bidang pekerjaan, latar sosial atau lingkungan kehidupan.
senses.nuances: 主要见于 walk of life，尤其是复数 walks of life；不宜把单独的 walk 普遍译为职业。[Collins：walk](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/walk)

collocations.en: people from all walks of life

collocations.zh: 来自不同生活背景的人
collocations.en: people from different walks of life

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kakitangan digalakkan berjalan kaki dari stesen ke pejabat melalui laluan pejalan kaki yang disediakan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 鼓励员工沿已设置的人行通道，从车站步行前往办公室。
dual_scenarios.en: Staff are encouraged to walk from the station to the office using the designated pedestrian route.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kita walk je ke kedai tu, dekat je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kita berjalan kaki sahaja ke kedai itu kerana jaraknya dekat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我们走去那家店就好，很近而已。
dual_scenarios.en: Let's just walk to that shop. It's really close.
spoken_features: walk 是英语动词，嵌入马来语口语句法
口语中的 ke 在此表达前往，标准句补为 ke kedai itu

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak walk ke kedai tu ke, atau naik kereta?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu mahu berjalan kaki ke kedai itu atau menaiki kereta?
messages.zh: 要走去那家店，还是开车去？
messages.en: Do you want to walk to that shop or drive?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Walk je lah, dekat je. Aku dah bawa payung.
messages.ms_standard: Kita berjalan kaki sahaja kerana jaraknya dekat. Saya sudah membawa payung.
messages.zh: 走过去就好啦，很近。我已经带伞了。
messages.en: Let's just walk. It's close, and I've brought an umbrella.

etymology.historical_story: Walk descends through Middle English from Old English verbs associated with rolling, tossing and working with the hands. Its meanings broadened before travelling on foot became central. That history is an English development: a Malay speaker using walk in conversation is switching languages, rather than using a word derived from Malay jalan. [Merriam-Webster: walk](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/walk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: walk 的 l 不出声：把它想成静静站在路边的人，让 /wɔːk/ 自己走过去。马来语对应 berjalan kaki。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 与熟悉英语的朋友交谈时可以语码转换；面向公众、长辈或正式受众时，berjalan kaki 通常更明确。邀请别人步行时也应顾及其行动能力。
